name: Gemini
removalRules: Protected inventory. The shared folder counts once. Credentials, settings, history, installed tools, cache folders, and unknown files stay protected.
note: Gemini CLI and Antigravity share `~/.gemini`. One root counts each byte once.

storage.name: Gemini and Antigravity shared data

section.title: Shared data

storage.explanation: Gemini CLI and Antigravity share this folder. Moppo keeps all files protected, including credentials, settings, and unknown files.
